name: Project S
summary:
Project S is a fast, explosive VR real time strategy game built for players who miss the addictive fun of classic 90s RTS games and want to feel that magic again in virtual reality.

Command your army from above a living tabletop battlefield. Capture factories, produce robotic units, steal vehicles, expand your territory, and crush the enemy base before they crush yours. Every mission is easy to understand, exciting to play, and full of tactical choices that reward speed, timing, and smart decisions.
